checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: A distinct, bright red patch is clearly visible above the eye region, matching the description of the caruncle.

artifact_observations.reasoning: Slight softness/bleeding at the boundary where the black belly meets the foreground grass. It mimics depth-of-field blur but lacks the crisp edge transition expected in a high-quality macro/wildlife shot.
